spans.s:
m. (-हः)
1 A bud, a blossom.
2 Mounting, ascending.
E.
रुह to grow, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
A rider, riding, mounted, one who rides on any animal or is carried in any vehicle.
m. (-कः)
1 A sort of goblin.
2 Rising, growing, mounting.
E.
रुह to rise, aff. वुन्.

m. (-गः)
The name of a mountain, Adam's peak in Ceylon.
E.
रोह rising, and ग what goes.

n. (-णं)
1 Semen virile.
2 Rising in or on, mounting, ascending.
3 Growing as a plant.
4 A mountain; see the last.
E.
रुह to grow, &c., aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-न्तः)
A kind of tree.
f. (-न्ती)
A sort of creeper.
E.
रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. झच्, fem, aff. ङीष्.

m. (-हिः)
1 A tree.
2 A seed.
3 A pious or religious man, one observing a vow, &c.
E.
रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. इन्.

m. (-णः)
1 The Indian fig tree.
2 A fragrant grass.
n. (-णं)
A part of the fore-noon, extending to mid-day, in which Śrāddhas are especially to be observed.
E.
रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. इनच्.

f. (-का)
A woman red with anger, &c. or with red pigments.
E.
रोहिणी fem. form, of रोहित red, and कन् added.

m. (-तिः)
The moon.
E.
रोहिणी the nymph, (see रोहिन्,) and पति husband.

m. (-भः)
The moon.
E.
रोहिणी the nymph, and वल्लभ the lover.

m. (-शः)
The moon.
E.
रोहिणी the nymph, and ईश lord or husband.

m. (-हित्)
The sun.
f. (-हित्)
1 A deer, a doe.
2 A sort of creeper.
E.
रुह to go or grow, Uṇādi aff. इति.

mfn. (रोहितः रोहिता or रोहिणी रोहितं)
Red, of a red colour.
m. (-तः)
1 Red, (the colour.)
2 The Rohi fish, (Cyprinus Rohita, HAM.)
3 A kind of deer.
4 A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaka, Rox.)
n. (-तं)
1 INDRA'S bow unbent and invisible to mortals.
2 Safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.)
3 Blood.
E.
रुह to grow or go, Uṇādi aff. इतन्.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaka, Rox.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-श्वः)
1 A name of

AGNI.
2

The son of HARIŚCANDRA.
E.
रेहित् a deer, or red, and अश्व a horse; also from रोहित sometimes read रोहिताश्व.

f. (-का)
A woman whose face is stained with red pigments, or who is red with rage, &c.
E.
रोहित red, fem. form, कन् added.

m. (-यः)
A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaka.)
E.
रोहित the same, ढक् pleonastic aff.

m. (-ही)
1 The Indian fig tree.
2 The holy fig tree.
3 The Andersonia Rohitaka.
f. (-हिणिः-हिणी)
1 The fourth lunar asterism, figured by a wheeled carriage, and containing five stars, probably, α β γ δ ε Tauri; in mythology, the asterism is personified as one of the daughters of Dakṣa, and wives of the moon.
2 The mother of BALARĀMA.
f. (-णी)
1 One of the Vidyādevīs of the

Jainas.
2

A cow.
3 Inflammatory affection of the throat.
4

Lightning.
5

The name of a medicinal plant.
6 The moon plant, (Asclepias acida.)
7 A woman stained with red pigments, or red with passion, &c.
8 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.)
9 Bengal madder.
10 A girl nine years old.
E.
रुह to grow, aff. णिनि.

n. (-षं)
A sort of grass.
m. (-षः)
1 The Rohi, a kind of fish.
2 A deer said to resemble an ass.
